meta.note: 所有转换行为都在本文件定义；krkr2renpy.py 不硬编码任何标签语义。

input.note: 汉化补丁多为 GBK/GB18030，gb18030 是 GBK 超集故排最前；kana guard 用于避免把日文原名误判成中文。

labels.note: 单下划线命名：A000.ks 的入口是 A000_entry，章节 chapter1_0 是 A000_chapter1_0。

header: # 本文件由 krkr2renpy 生成；行尾 # L#### 指向 .ks 原始行号。
output.note: 背景一律直接 scene，不再使用 onlayer backdrop。

memory.regions_note: regions 仅作文档用；实际插入由 scene_mode/loops/segments 决定。

startadv.note: KAG ADV 窗口切换；内置屏幕已等价

startnovel.note: KAG NVL 窗口切换；需人工

evtf.reason: CG 回览标记（sf.album_flag），需为 Ren'Py 相册重新实现

scef.reason: 回想场景标记（sf.scene_flag），需为 Ren'Py 回想重新实现

evtcg.reason: CG 标记 + image 包装宏

quake.reason: 震屏演出（可改用 ATL vpunch/hpunch，需人工确认幅度）

trans.reason: 手工转场（[trans] 依赖 KAG 双缓冲）

graph.reason: 文本内联图像（[graph]），需确认尺寸与基线

position.reason: 消息层布局（[position]），内置屏幕不兼容

button.reason: KAG 图形按钮，需改写为 Ren'Py screen

cm.note: 清空消息层光标，say 屏幕自动处理

s.note: KAG 停止执行等待点击；Ren'Py say 天然等待

wt.note: KAG 转场等待；Ren'Py with 同步等待

cancelskip.note: 跳过控制由 Ren'Py 接管

clickskip.note: 跳过控制由 Ren'Py 接管

bgmopt.note: BGM 音量；Ren'Py 由偏好设置接管

seopt.note: SE 音量；Ren'Py 由偏好设置接管

templates.screens_rpy:
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# =============================================================================
# 界面层（由 krkr2renpy 自动生成）
# 包含：对话框 / 选项 / 主菜单 / 快捷菜单 / 总菜单 / 历史 / 存档读档 / 设置 / 确认框
#
# 说明：
#   * 纯内联样式，不依赖 gui.rpy，任何项目都能直接运行
#   * 中文界面如需中文字体：把字体放到 game/fonts/ 下，并取消下面
#     "style default" 里 font 那一行的注释、填上字体文件名
#   * 历史记录采用翻页式（更省内存、更适合手柄）
#   * 键盘 Esc / 手柄 Start 或 Minus 呼出总菜单
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 基础样式
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

style default:
    size 26
    color "#f2f2f5"
    outlines [ (2, "#00000099", 0, 0) ]
{FONT_LINE}

style ruby_style is default:
    size 14
    yoffset -16

style button:
    padding (12, 8, 12, 8)
    background "#ffffff10"
    hover_background "#ffffff22"

style button_text:
    size 28
    color "#ffffff"
    hover_color "#ffd1e4"
    selected_color "#ffd1e4"
    insensitive_color "#9a9aa4"
    outlines [ (2, "#000000", 0, 0) ]

style bar:
    xsize 320
    ysize 20
    left_bar Solid("#ff9ec4")
    right_bar Solid("#ffffff30")
    thumb None
    thumb_shadow None

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 对话框（底部一条横带，不再整屏蒙黑）
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

style say_window:
    background "#000000c4"
    xfill True
    ysize 190
    yalign 1.0
    padding (60, 20, 60, 26)

style say_who:
    color "#ffb8d2"
    size 28
    outlines [ (2, "#000000cc", 0, 0) ]

style say_dialogue:
    color "#ffffff"
    size 26
    line_leading 12
    ruby_style style.ruby_style
    outlines [ (2, "#000000aa", 0, 0) ]

style namebox:
    background "#000000b4"
    xpos 40
    ypos -46
    padding (20, 6, 20, 6)

screen say(who, what):
    window:
        id "window"
        style "say_window"

        if who is not None:
            window:
                id "namebox"
                style "namebox"
                text who id "who" style "say_who"

        text what id "what" style "say_dialogue"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 选项
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

style choice_button is button:
    xsize 620
    xalign 0.5

style choice_button_text is button_text:
    text_align 0.5

screen choice(items):
    style_prefix "choice"

    vbox:
        xalign 0.5
        yalign 0.45
        spacing 16

        for i in items:
            textbutton i.caption action i.action

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 快捷菜单（对话时右上角，打开菜单会自动隐藏）
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

default quick_menu = True

init python:
    if "quick_menu" not in config.overlay_screens:
        config.overlay_screens.append("quick_menu")

screen quick_menu():
    zorder 100

    if quick_menu:
        frame:
            background "#00000077"
            xalign 1.0
            yalign 0.0
            xoffset -14
            yoffset 10
            padding (16, 8, 16, 8)

            hbox:
                spacing 14

                textbutton "历史" action ShowMenu("history") text_size 21
                textbutton "自动" action Preference("auto-forward", "toggle") text_size 21
                textbutton "跳过" action Skip() alternate Skip(fast=True, confirm=True) text_size 21
                textbutton "保存" action ShowMenu("save") text_size 21
                textbutton "读取" action ShowMenu("load") text_size 21
                textbutton "设置" action ShowMenu("prefs") text_size 21
                textbutton "隐藏" action HideInterface() text_size 21

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 总菜单（菜单键呼出）
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

init 999 python:
    # 引擎默认 _game_menu_screen 可能为 None（按菜单键没反应），这里指定成总菜单。
    store._game_menu_screen = "game_menu"

screen game_menu():
    modal True
    add Solid("#0a0a10f0")

    frame:
        background "#12121aee"
        xalign 0.5
        yalign 0.5
        xsize 620
        padding (40, 34, 40, 34)

        vbox:
            spacing 12
            xfill True

            text "菜单" size 34 xalign 0.5
            null height 8

            textbutton "返回游戏" action Return()
            textbutton "历史记录" action ShowMenu("history")
            textbutton "保存进度" action ShowMenu("save")
            textbutton "读取进度" action ShowMenu("load")
            textbutton "设置" action ShowMenu("prefs")
            textbutton "返回主菜单" action MainMenu(confirm=True)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 主菜单
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

label main_menu:
    call screen main_menu

    if _return == "start":
        return
    elif _return == "load":
        call screen load
        jump main_menu
    elif _return == "prefs":
        call screen prefs
        jump main_menu
    else:
        jump main_menu

screen main_menu():
    modal True

    # 有标题图就用，没有就纯色背景
    if renpy.loadable("images/ui/title.png"):
        add "images/ui/title.png"
    else:
        add Solid("#1a1a2e")

    frame:
        background "#0000009e"
        xalign 0.985
        yalign 0.5
        xsize 300
        padding (26, 24, 26, 24)

        vbox:
            spacing 10
            xfill True

            text "[config.name!t]" size 20 color "#ffffffcc" xalign 0.5
            null height 6

            textbutton "开始游戏" action Return("start")
            textbutton "读取存档" action Return("load")
            textbutton "设置" action Return("prefs")
            textbutton "退出游戏" action Quit(confirm=True)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 历史记录（翻页式）
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

screen history():
    modal True
    add Solid("#0a0a10f0")

    default hist_page = 0

    $ per_page = 7
    $ total = len(_history_list)
    $ pages = max(1, (total + per_page - 1) // per_page)
    $ cur = max(0, min(hist_page, pages - 1))
    $ page_end = total - cur * per_page
    $ page_start = max(0, page_end - per_page)

    frame:
        background "#12121aee"
        xalign 0.5
        yalign 0.5
        xsize 920
        ysize 690
        padding (30, 22, 30, 22)

        vbox:
            spacing 10

            text "历史记录" size 34 xalign 0.5

            frame:
                background "#ffffff08"
                xfill True
                ysize 470
                padding (18, 12, 18, 12)

                vbox:
                    spacing 14

                    if not total:
                        text "（还没有对话记录）" size 26 color "#aaaaaa" xalign 0.5

                    for h in _history_list[page_start:page_end]:
                        vbox:
                            spacing 3

                            if h.who:
                                $ who_color = "#ffb8d2"
                                if h.who_args and "color" in h.who_args:
                                    $ who_color = h.who_args["color"]
                                text h.who substitute False size 23 color who_color

                            $ what_text = renpy.filter_text_tags(h.what or "", allow=[])
                            text what_text substitute False size 23

            hbox:
                spacing 24
                xalign 0.5

                textbutton "更早" action SetScreenVariable("hist_page", cur + 1) sensitive (cur + 1 < pages)
                text ("第 " + str(cur + 1) + " / " + str(pages) + " 页") size 22 yalign 0.5
                textbutton "更新" action SetScreenVariable("hist_page", max(0, cur - 1)) sensitive (cur > 0)

            textbutton "返回" action Return()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 存档 / 读档
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

screen save():
    modal True
    use file_slots("保存进度", True)

screen load():
    modal True
    use file_slots("读取进度", False)

screen file_slots(title, do_save):
    add Solid("#0a0a10f0")

    frame:
        background "#12121aee"
        xalign 0.5
        yalign 0.5
        xsize 900
        ysize 700
        padding (28, 22, 28, 22)

        vbox:
            spacing 12

            text title size 34 xalign 0.5

            grid 3 2:
                spacing 14
                xalign 0.5

                for i in range(6):
                    $ slot = i + 1

                    button:
                        xysize (262, 230)
                        background "#ffffff10"
                        hover_background "#ffffff28"
                        padding (10, 8, 10, 8)

                        action (FileSave(slot, confirm=True) if do_save else FileLoad(slot))

                        vbox:
                            spacing 6
                            xalign 0.5

                            add FileScreenshot(slot) xysize (242, 182) xalign 0.5
                            text FileTime(slot, format="%m-%d %H:%M", empty="空槽位") size 18 xalign 0.5

            hbox:
                spacing 24
                xalign 0.5

                textbutton "上一页" action FilePagePrevious()
                $ page_no = FileCurrentPage()
                text ("第 " + str(page_no) + " 页") size 24 yalign 0.5
                textbutton "下一页" action FilePageNext()

            textbutton "返回" action Return()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 设置
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

screen prefs():
    modal True
    add Solid("#0a0a10f0")

    frame:
        background "#12121aee"
        xalign 0.5
        yalign 0.5
        xsize 860
        ysize 650
        padding (40, 28, 40, 28)

        vbox:
            spacing 14

            text "设置" size 34 xalign 0.5

            hbox:
                spacing 20
                text "文字速度" size 26 yalign 0.5 xsize 170
                bar value Preference("text speed") yalign 0.5

            hbox:
                spacing 20
                text "自动前进" size 26 yalign 0.5 xsize 170
                bar value Preference("auto-forward time") yalign 0.5

            null height 10

            hbox:
                spacing 20
                text "音乐音量" size 26 yalign 0.5 xsize 170
                bar value Preference("music volume") yalign 0.5

            hbox:
                spacing 20
                text "音效音量" size 26 yalign 0.5 xsize 170
                bar value Preference("sound volume") yalign 0.5

            hbox:
                spacing 20
                text "语音音量" size 26 yalign 0.5 xsize 170
                bar value Preference("voice volume") yalign 0.5

            null height 10

            $ skip_all = _preferences.skip_unseen
            $ wait_voice = _preferences.wait_voice

            textbutton ("跳过未读文本：开" if skip_all else "跳过未读文本：关") action Preference("skip", "toggle") xalign 0.5
            textbutton ("自动前进等待语音：开" if wait_voice else "自动前进等待语音：关") action Preference("wait for voice", "toggle") xalign 0.5

            textbutton "返回" action Return()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 确认框
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

screen confirm(message, yes_action, no_action):
    modal True
    zorder 200

    add Solid("#000000aa")

    frame:
        background "#12121aee"
        xalign 0.5
        yalign 0.5
        xsize 620
        padding (50, 40, 50, 40)

        vbox:
            spacing 30
            xalign 0.5

            text _(message) xalign 0.5 text_align 0.5 size 26

            hbox:
                spacing 90
                xalign 0.5

                textbutton "确定" action yes_action
                textbutton "取消" action no_action

screen yesno_prompt(message, yes_action, no_action):
    use confirm(message, yes_action, no_action)
